_meta.source: PSA Q4 2024 PSGC release, mirrored via https://psgc.gitlab.io/api/

schema.name: Barangay name as published by PSA (may include '(Pob.)' poblacion marker)
schema.province: 4-digit province code, or null for HUC/NCR barangays not under any province

notes: Barangay names are NOT unique nationwide (e.g., 'San Isidro', 'Poblacion', 'San Roque' each appear hundreds of times). Use findBarangay(code) for an exact single match; findBarangaysByName(name) returns all matches.
cityMunCode joins cleanly to every entry in @ph-dev-utils/core's PSGC cities/municipalities dataset (verified: 0 orphans).
Manila barangays link to the single Manila city entry (133900); the PSA sub-municipality layer (Tondo, Sampaloc, etc.) is not represented in this schema.
province: null indicates an HUC or NCR barangay not nested under a province (1,792 entries). Look up by region instead.
Derived from the current 9-digit PSGC; parent code taken from the API's municipalityCode/cityCode reference, not by string-slicing the barangay code.
